The '''Eighty-third Battalion''' was a unit within the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that served in the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was invaded by the Empire<ref name="Firestorm" /> in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> the battalion was sent under the command of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Brint]] to aid in the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Brint established a base in the [[Corellian Science Museum]] in the [[Axial Park]] district of Corellia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], where he worked under the command of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] to aid the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the military's operations on the world.<ref name="Firestorm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eighty-third Battalion was first mentioned in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "Firestorm" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The battalion is only mentioned if the player speaks to Brint after the mission's first cutscene, and it is not identified whether the [[Republic trooper|troopers]] in the museum&mdash;who wear the same white and blue armor as the other troopers across the planet&mdash;are part of the battalion.<ref name="Firestorm" />
